o.en:
This workflow provides a very basic guide on how to apply SDXL checkpoints, LoRA, and FaceDetailer, making it easy for beginners to follow. Each step is clearly separated into different sections to help users understand the process without confusion.

The workflow is designed to be simple and effective, focusing on the key elements of SDXL generation while enhancing face details using FaceDetailer.

To use FaceDetailer in this workflow, you will need to install the ComfyUI Impact Pack, as it contains the necessary nodes for FaceDetailer to function properly.
